article: all (in particular its final article on publication and entry into force)
why: Commercial Code 187 مكرر and 187 مكرر 1 take the publication of Law 05-02 as the line between the two regimes; the store holds only the amended Commercial Code articles and notes that the commencement is unsettled, so the law's own articles are needed to read around that date.
Commercial Code 195 ¶2 applies the summons periods of article 26 of the former Code of Civil Procedure to the president's hearing on renewal terms; that code is not in the store.
